reviewed.disposition: Raw read is selected human-maintained PROJECT_PROFILE.md; operational completion and audit delegate to evaluateAudit.
scenarioPath is explicit validated project-local reference input; trace/metrics use a project read snapshot; evaluation and audit event publish through a task transaction.
baselinePath is explicit project-local comparison input with containment/schema checks; operational metrics and contract are read through the project snapshot.
Enumerates repository test source directories; source code remains file-owned by the plan.
Utility is read canonically; probe copies repository source excluding .forgeloop/.git and modifies only a disposable temporary copy. No operational mirror writer.
Reads selected human-maintained profile; source registry uses artifact reader and is intentionally file-owned input.
Scans repository source for policy checks; excludes .forgeloop from recursive scans. Explicit source-file arrays remain policy inputs.
Host-owned authority files are external to the target; target-contained sources refuse trusted admission. No task operational storage writer.
Raw filesystem realpath resolves Git/worktree identity; operational workspace binding uses canonical artifacts and task transactions.
Reads project package.json for command resolution; package manifests remain repository inputs.

Selected canonical statement bytes are materialized in an isolated temporary directory for the external signer; statement freshness rechecked; temporary output cleaned. Native write transaction forbidden during signer callback.

External signer writes temporary bundle; immutable attachment is staged through active preparation, with statement freshness and regular-file/no-symlink checks; canonical output without native preparation refuses.

limitations: Bounded source review; does not prove all dynamic/transitive consumers.
Evidence does not upgrade pending platform runs or validate every external-input safety property.

retrieval.fallback: Exact searches and direct source reads for the12 bounded reviewed modules.
